description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Glimmerpost from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Play Glimmerpost, triggering it and Fastbond.
Resolve the Glimmerpost trigger, causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Resolve the Fastbond trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Activate Glimmerpost by tapping it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
